###### Abstract. [...] ITME implements differentiated fallback policies for cache misses. While a model weight miss inevitably triggers a pipeline stall, a KV cache miss is resolved through dynamic recomputation on the GPU. This design choice avoids the inefficiency of retrieving isolated missing blocks from the remote tier, which would necessitate either suboptimal chunk-sized transfers or complex retrieval logic.
